author: XBOX
description:
Terrible Lizards officially stomps onto Xbox Game Pass on October 29th!

Something’s stirring on the forgotten sidelines of Route 66. Broken down, you stumble into Dalton's Dinos, a roadside dinosaur attraction that's strangely quiet for the time of day. With no one around and something seemingly moving among the exhibits, a desperate call for help sends you searching…

But the colorful mascots and uncanny animatronics are only the beginning. Your search leads into sprawling underground caverns, where the dinosaurs are no longer part of the show and you’re the next meal.

Run, jump, slide, climb and wall run through the darkness, using fast-paced movement and your surroundings to stay alive and uncover just how deep the mystery of Dalton's Dinos goes. 

Stay quiet, or risk the wrath of the park’s not quite shut down inhabitants… or worse…
